sheets.prompt:
Create a crisp high-resolution PNG icon sheet for MONO Glyph, the EXPRESSION OUTLINE variant. The attached image is the authoritative style reference: match its exact visual family, line weight relative to icon size, gently irregular rounded geometry, and sparse expressive faces. Black ink on pure white. Friendly enclosed outlined objects with transparent-looking white interiors, thick smooth monoline contours with round caps, small curved smiles or two short vertical eyes. Flat 2D icon artwork only. Keep marks sparse and readable; functional recognition comes first. Every suitable enclosed icon should have a small expression as in the reference; open arrows and mathematical symbols can stay pure rounded strokes when a face would obscure their meaning. DO NOT use generic thin system icons, solid blob silhouettes for unselected icons, gradients, shadows, textures, 3D, labels, numerals outside the artwork, captions or decorative borders. For explicitly SELECTED states, keep the same outline silhouette but fill the main body charcoal with tiny white facial marks, so selection stays visible. Consistent optical size, ample whitespace. Strict 5-column grid, icon positions reading left to right, top to bottom. Exactly 20 icons, 4 rows. Row 1: home [首页] — rounded house with a small curved smile; podcast [播客] — round podcast bubble with two short expressive eyes; library [音乐库] — rounded little suitcase with a small curved smile; search [搜索] — round magnifying glass with a small smile; profile [我的] — soft droplet face with two short eyes.
Row 2: homeFilled [首页 · 选中] — SELECTED filled state; podcastFilled [播客 · 选中] — SELECTED filled state; libraryFilled [音乐库 · 选中] — SELECTED filled state; profileFilled [我的 · 选中] — SELECTED filled state; stop [停止].
Row 3: liked [已喜欢] — SELECTED filled state; repeatMode [列表循环]; repeatOne [单曲循环]; shuffle [随机播放]; refresh [刷新].
Row 4: playCircle [圆形播放]; playCircleFill [圆形播放 · 实心] — SELECTED filled state; playNext [下一首播放]; addToQueue [加入播放队列]; rewind15 [后退 15 秒].
Treat names beginning with cat as CONTENT CATEGORIES, not cats. Never print the identifiers or Chinese labels. Use 2048 x 2048 if available.

podcastReplacement.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design a minimal MONO music-app PODCAST icon as a soft SOUND BUBBLE, using the attached original reference for its restrained geometric personality, confident round black contours, and tiny expressive incisions. Exactly four matched icon variants on a pure white 1254 square PNG sheet, evenly centered in a 2x2 grid with generous whitespace. This must be as visually simple as the five reference icons: one outer contour plus only TWO SHORT interior marks. Shape: a softly asymmetric oval speech bubble, subtly wider than tall, with one very short integrated tail at lower LEFT (subtle soft corner, not a separate triangle), top gently convex, no bottom stalk. Inside only two vertical rounded voice slots, the left slightly shorter than the right, subtly tilted together. No third mark, no smile, no lines surrounding the shape. Top row classic family: left regular thick outline black on white with two black voice slots, right same exact silhouette filled black and two white slots. Bottom row expressive family: same simple voice-bubble concept with a softer plumper contour and slightly jauntier slots, left outline, right solid; matching normal/selected pairs must have identical geometry. Keep the thick outline 7-8 percent of icon width, interior slots chunky but SHORT, like the eyes on the rightmost reference icon. Each icon approx 270 pixels wide, optically balanced, flat crisp monochrome black with clean white cutouts, no texture or shading. Premium compact rounded geometric mark, not a literal equipment illustration. Absolutely NO microphones, headphones, headsets, radio, antennas, soundwave rings, people, central stem, mouths, gradients, shadows, text, labels, extra decorative elements. The two rows should feel like siblings in the same MONO family, not four different concepts.
